title: Superpower #4: Stretch for Amazing
coreMove: Raise the ceiling without cutting the tether to evidence, effort, and ownership.
sourcePressure: The fourth superpower introduces stretch: ambitious reach beyond safe incremental targets, held by effort and accountability.
chapterSpecificMisunderstanding: Do not make stretch mean fantasy targets, hustle rhetoric, or reckless overpromising.

sourceAnchors.name: stretch for amazing
sourceAnchors.detail: The source introduces stretch as the fourth OKR superpower: ambitious reach beyond safe incremental targets with serious effort and accountability.
sourceAnchors.phrasingHint: Stretch raises the ceiling, but the score line keeps the bigger ambition from turning into performance theater.

hook: A team discovers OKRs in a conference room and suddenly gets aligned
A dashboard glows on a Monday morning and reveals the truth
A leader writes a goal on a whiteboard and everyone understands
opening with Superpower #4: Stretch for Amazing as a definition rather than a pressure
counterintuition: Measurement is not bureaucracy, it is clarity
Goals are not dreams, they are systems
Accountability is not punishment, it is ownership
stretch is not a mindset, it is a system
tryThisNow: Set a timer and write three goals
Ask yourself what matters most right now
write one OKR without checking whether it changes behavior
examples: generic startup roadmap meeting with sticky notes
home chore chart with vague family goals
student group in a classroom choosing priorities
team lead reviewing a color-coded dashboard
